desc:
⛰️ **Welcome to Cinderela!** 🌄

Enjoy exciting mountain climbing obby adventures, relax while enjoying the scenery, and play with friends!

🎣 **Fishing** - Discover various types of interesting fish, ranging from common to forgotten!

💕 **Relationships** - Build relationships with partners or best friends, increase relationship levels, and create shared memories!

🎵 Music | 🚲 Bicycle | 🕺 Free Avatar | 🔊 Boombox | 💃 Emote & Dance

🏆 **Leaderboard** - Show your skills and make your name on the rankings!

👑 **Free Title** - Get a free title by reaching a certain number of Summits!

🔥 **Explore the mountains, catch rare fish, build relationships, unlock titles, and make your mark on the leaderboard!**
